verdict.rationale: Navan's in-product AI assistant Ava is described as analyzing real-time spend data, summarizing spend by month and category, comparing spend to policy, predicting future spend, and proactively suggesting savings. The product also shows a data-driven "price to beat" suggestion on every hotel search. The MCP server adds natural-language spend analysis, but that runs in external AI tools rather than inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Ava's insights, in-depth first-party documentation (Ava is evidenced only by a marketing blog post), and detail on how and where proactive suggestions appear in the product.
